CONSENSUS_QUALITY.describes: consensus-quality state (market and hockey agree on a strong near-even side); never a pick on its own

EGGY_PICK.describes: Eggy's daily bets (the whole record of the product)

FAMILY_MARKET_PRICE.describes: sides with supported market movement present (evidence family)

FAMILY_PROVEN_SIGNAL.describes: sides with a proven model-market signal present (evidence family)

FAMILY_SITUATIONAL.describes: sides with a situational advantage present (evidence family)

MARKET_SITUATIONAL_OPPORTUNITY.describes: evidence structure: sound hockey picture plus measured market / situational facts (Type C)

ML_MODEL_GAP_3PLUS.describes: the moneyline side the hockey model rates 3+ points above the market

MOVE_AWAY_NOTABLE.describes: the moneyline side the price moved away from by a NOTABLE or EXCEPTIONAL amount

MOVE_TOWARD_NOTABLE.describes: the moneyline side the price moved toward by a NOTABLE or EXCEPTIONAL amount (upper quartile of ordinary same-day moves or more)

PICK_BEST_AVAILABLE.describes: daily bets chosen as the best available with no edge thesis (LOW confidence)

PICK_BEST_AVAILABLE_CLEAN_PERSONNEL.describes: best-available bets with no goalie or material injury uncertainty at decision time

PICK_BEST_AVAILABLE_PERSONNEL_ISSUE.describes: best-available bets with a goalie or material injury uncertainty at decision time

PICK_EDGE_THESIS.describes: daily bets that carried an edge thesis

PICK_EDGE_THESIS_CLEAN_PERSONNEL.describes: edge-thesis bets with no goalie or material injury uncertainty at decision time

PICK_EDGE_THESIS_PERSONNEL_ISSUE.describes: edge-thesis bets with a goalie or material injury uncertainty at decision time

PICK_GOALIES_BOTH_CONFIRMED.describes: daily bets where both starting goalies were CONFIRMED at decision time

PICK_GOALIES_ONE_PROBABLE.describes: daily bets where a starting goalie was only PROBABLE (the other confirmed or probable) at decision time

PICK_GOALIES_SOURCE_CONFLICT.describes: daily bets where the goalie sources disagreed at decision time

PICK_GOALIES_UNKNOWN.describes: daily bets where a starting goalie was UNKNOWN (no listing, or a stale one) at decision time

PICK_GOALIE_LATE_CHANGE.describes: daily bets in games where a listed starter changed after it was first seen

PICK_INJURY_COVERAGE_NONE.describes: daily bets where no attributable injury report existed for either team at decision time (absences unknown)

PICK_INJURY_SOURCE_CONFLICT.describes: daily bets where injury sources disagreed about a MATERIAL player at decision time

PICK_IN_PREFERRED_PRICE.describes: daily bets priced inside the preferred near-even region

PICK_MATERIAL_PLAYER_IN_DOUBT.describes: daily bets where a MATERIAL player on either team was questionable / day-to-day / a game-time decision at decision time

PICK_MATERIAL_PLAYER_RETURN.describes: daily bets where a MATERIAL player had just returned from an absence on either team at decision time

PICK_NO_MATERIAL_PERSONNEL_ISSUE.describes: daily bets with injury coverage on record and no material absence, doubt or conflict at decision time

PICK_OPPONENT_MATERIAL_ABSENCE.describes: daily bets where the opponent was missing a MATERIAL player (fresh attributable report) at decision time

PICK_OUTSIDE_PREFERRED_PRICE.describes: daily bets priced outside the preferred region

PICK_OWN_MATERIAL_ABSENCE.describes: daily bets where the picked team was missing a MATERIAL player (fresh attributable report) at decision time

PICK_PUCK_LINE.describes: daily bets that were puck lines

PICK_UNRESOLVED_GAME_TIME_DECISION.describes: daily bets where a MATERIAL player on either team was still a game-time decision when the pick was made

PL_MODEL_GAP_3PLUS.describes: the puck-line side the model's goal-margin mapping rates 3+ points above the market

PRICE_IN_PREFERRED.describes: a qualifying side priced inside the preferred near-even region

PRICE_OUTSIDE_PREFERRED.describes: a qualifying side priced outside the preferred region

REST_ADVANTAGE.describes: the side that is rested when its opponent is on a back-to-back

SUPPORTED_MARKET_GAP.describes: evidence structure: a model-market gap the record has proven (Type B)

eggy.note: Eggy's Parlay Pick of the Day is separate: one official pick a day, its own ledger

learning_experiment.ends_automatically: the 14-day EXPERIMENT window ends 2026-11-02 (Eastern) and stays identifiable in the ledger; the learning parlays CONTINUE as the production engine after it

intelligence.architecture: game -> player -> market -> disagreement -> argue against -> decide -> rank and record

learning_experiment.label: 14-DAY POSTMORTEM LEARNING EXPERIMENT

bankroll.label: separate experiment bankroll (not Eggy's paper bankroll)
bankroll.note: betting P/L is from settled tickets only; resets and the initial funding are funding events, never profit

postmortem.closing_price_movement: not available: closing prices are not captured for these bets, so no closing-line value is claimed

decision_review.note: OUTCOME (win/loss) and DECISION (good/questionable/bad) are separate results. The decision is judged from the pre-bet review alone; a good decision that lost is not a mistake, and a bad decision that won is not skill. NORMAL_VARIANCE is used only when earned.

dependence.not_captured: One-plus shots ladders and offered same-game parlay prices are not captured by this system (1+ shots is not a validated threshold, and no parlay-price source exists); no parlay value is claimed.
dependence.reading: 1 same-game pairs both hit against 1.6 expected if independent: fewer joint hits than independence predicts

evidence_health.controlled_refresh: a candidate is prepared automatically every 14 days (operational/evidence_refresh.py): a routine refresh rolls forward by itself and is recorded in the evidence history; only a MATERIAL change waits for the owner (python3 -m deploy.promote_evidence --approve ...)

moneyline_model_vs_market.note: expected = the MARKET's no-vig probability for the side; a model edge is real only if the side beats it

moneyline_trust.reading: positive z: the hockey model's pregame probabilities beat the market's no-vig probabilities on log loss; the model counts as leading only at z >= 2 over 100+ games; until then the market's probability is the estimate and the model's disagreement is shown, not trusted

points.validated_through: 2025-26 and 2026-27 to date (Platt for points>=1 and >=2 fitted on 2024-25, so out of time)

priced_metrics.why: no combined sportsbook price exists for the learning parlays, so no ROI, expected value or closing-line value is computed (none is shown as zero)

tickets.probability_basis: the ticket's combined probability where one is given, else the product of its legs' estimates (an independence assumption)

lesson_state.consumed_by: operational.eggy_intelligence._load_overlay_inputs -> recency_overlay (POSTMORTEM_ROLE_CAUTION flag; its measured adjustment through apply_signal_evidence)

models.name: Skater matchup projection
models.purpose: Expected time on ice, power-play time, shots, goals, assists, points, hits and blocks per player and opponent; threshold probabilities for shots (1+ to 5+), points (1+, 2+), goals (1+), assists, hits, blocks.

validation.method: Chronological walk; train 2022-24 fit, calibration season 2024-25 (dispersion, Platt), final evaluation 2025-26 scored once; compared with the recent 30-game rate and the previous live formula; Brier, log loss, calibration tables, limited-history and changed-role slices.

limits: The starter must be confirmed: a saves leg exists only for a goalie whose start is confirmed by the team's own post (read automatically from Daily Faceoff) or recorded by hand; a beat reporter's 'Confirmed' is kept as an expectation unless the owner opts in. The gate is not bypassed.
The fitted calibration did not improve held-out log loss, so raw probabilities are used.
models.name: Goalie saves and goals against
models.purpose: Expected shots against, save percentage, saves and goals against for a named goalie and opponent, with an 80% range and a saves ladder 24+ to 34+.

limits: The named-goalie adjustment did not improve held-out forecasts; it is a scenario, not the probability.

Puck line: a margin model built on this strength rating (Poisson goals) did NOT beat the base-rate baseline on held-out games (over-predicts home -1.5 covers); that result stays on record. A direct-logistic alternative beats the base rate on two earlier development folds, but nothing is enabled until it is scored on games it has never seen (2026-27, collecting) and prices and settlement exist.

Moneyline: this model is NOT what prices tickets; the Elo path (heuristic band) does. On the same games the two are statistically indistinguishable (docs/validation/moneyline_model_comparison.json) and neither is shown to beat a sportsbook price, so no promotion was made. A versioned opt-in switch and a shadow scoreboard (below) collect market-inclusive evidence on live games.
models.name: Team strength and win probability
models.purpose: Home/away win probability from decayed goal differential (shootouts counted in the result for display).

policy.summary: up to 1 ticket a day (zero is allowed); each +100 or better and no longer than +500, 2 to 5 legs (the fewest that qualify), every leg from a different game; legs are well supported (2+ shots for a player who reaches the line in most of his last 30 games, or a moneyline at the market's own chance), never points or goal bets; estimated hit chance of at least 30%; estimated value of at least +5%, at least +3% after lowering every leg by 3 points, and not negative if the true chance is halfway between the player's record and the price; ranked by estimated hit chance; each player on at most 1 ticket a day

previous_day.note: Each game on that slate had analysis available from the projections; prices were bought for the games the day's odds credits covered (the free allowance is about 11 credits a day), so the rest could be analysed but not priced. Games without prices are listed on the board with the reason.

closest.note: The closest combination inside +100 to +500 (best value after the haircut). It does NOT qualify: shown so the analysis is not hidden, not as a recommendation.

primary.price_note: Calculated price: the product of the legs' DraftKings prices. The legs are from different games, so no combined quote exists or is needed; a same-game combination would need a quoted combined price, and none is available from this feed, so none is ever built.

tickets.label: US-feed paper experiment. Prices are DraftKings (US feed via The Odds API) and have NOT been matched to DraftKings Ontario. Player probabilities come from a projection model validated on one held-out season (2025-26; earlier seasons fitted it) and, for shots legs on tickets, each player's recent record (docs/MODEL_VALIDATION.md, docs/ANCHOR_TICKETS.md); they are estimates, not proof of an edge, and there are no historical DraftKings prices to test profitability against.

ticket_policy.summary: up to 1 ticket a day (zero is allowed); each +100 or better and no longer than +500, 2 to 5 legs (the fewest that qualify), every leg from a different game; legs are well supported (2+ shots for a player who reaches the line in most of his last 30 games, or a moneyline at the market's own chance), never points or goal bets; estimated hit chance of at least 30%; estimated value of at least +5%, at least +3% after lowering every leg by 3 points, and not negative if the true chance is halfway between the player's record and the price; ranked by estimated hit chance; each player on at most 1 ticket a day
